name: rigel
label: Rigel (beta Ori, B8 Ia)
sources: Aufdenberg et al. 2008 / CHARA: theta_LD ~ 2.75 mas (ASSUMED 2.76 +/- 0.03)
notes: B supergiant with variable H-alpha emission; dec -8: 38 deg at transit from Calern.
